summary: FortuneX Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K/A amending its September 22, 2026 report on the September 18, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with WT Realty Group Inc. The Cayman SPAC will domesticate to Delaware and merge a wholly-owned subsidiary into WT Realty, which survives as a subsidiary of renamed PubCo. The amendment corrects Item 1.01 disclosure, supplements PubCo governance disclosure, and replaces the Amended and Restated Registration Rights Agreement exhibit. No price per share, premium, or close date stated. Watch redemption levels, shareholder vote timing, and regulatory clearance.
